Quick answers

Before you write to us

The three questions we hear most often. For fees, batch dates and course-specific prerequisites, send the form above or WhatsApp us.

Is the trial session really free?
Yes — completely free, with no commitment required. We want you to experience the teaching quality and learning environment before making any decision.
How soon can I start after enrolling?
Most batches begin within 1–2 weeks of enrolment. We confirm your exact start date during the onboarding call after you submit the enquiry form.
Do you offer online sessions?
Yes — live online, recorded and hybrid options are all available. Every session is fully interactive, faculty-led and recorded for enrolled students to replay.
